answer_1.quote: LLMs have a significant impact on the daily work of many, as they are practical to use and assist in solving natural text problems ranging from creative writing to math problems.

answer_2.quote: GPT-4-as-a-judge was utilized to rate the model responses for each individually and turn-based on a range from 1 to 10.

answer_3.quote: With MT-Bench a cost-effective automatic evaluation alternative, that correlates with human judgment was developed for English. For automation MT-Bench utilizes LLMs-as-a-judge.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on pair-wise model assessment on the German MT-Bench-DE. Therefore, we provide the annotation platform depicted in Figure , in which academic, native-speaking Germans pair-wise assess model responses by selecting either a clear winner, denoting a tie or signaling that both models were not helpful at all in answering the multi-turn user request.
answer_4.guideline: Please act as an impartial judge and evaluate the quality of the responses provided by two AI assistants to the user question displayed below.
